name: Copper
description: Gain 1 coin.

name: Silver
description: Gain 2 coins.

name: Gold
description: Gain 3 coins.

name: Estate
description: Worth 1 VP.

name: Duchy
description: Worth 3 VP.

name: Province
description: Worth 6 VP.

name: Curse
description: Worth -1 VP.

name: Gardens
description: Worth 1 VP per 10 cards you own, rounded down.

name: Adventurer
description: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal 2 resources. Put those resources into your hand and discard the other revealed cards.

name: Artisan
description: Gain a card costing up to 5 to your hand. Put a card from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Bandit
description: Gain a Gold. Attack: reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Trash one revealed resource other than Copper, then discard the rest.

name: Bureaucrat
description: Gain a Silver on top of your deck. Attack: put a victory card from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Cellar
description: Gain 1 action. Discard any number of cards, then draw one card for each card discarded.

name: Chancellor
description: Gain 2 coins. Put your deck into your discard pile.

name: Chapel
description: Trash up to 4 cards from your hand.

name: Council Room
description: Draw 4 cards. Gain 1 buy. Each other player draws a card.

name: Feast
description: Trash this card. Gain a card costing up to 5.

name: Festival
description: Gain 2 actions, 1 buy, and 2 coins.

name: Harbinger
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. You may put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Laboratory
description: Draw 2 cards. Gain 1 action.

name: Library
description: Draw until you have 7 cards in your hand. Whenever you reveal an action card, you may set it aside instead. Discard cards set aside this way afterward.

name: Market
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action, 1 buy, and 1 coin.

name: Merchant
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. When you play your first Silver this turn, gain 1 extra coin.

name: Mine
description: You may trash a resource from your hand. If you do, gain a resource to your hand costing up to 3 more.

name: Moneylender
description: You may trash a Copper from your hand. If you do, gain 3 coins.

name: Poacher
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action and 1 coin. Discard one card for each empty supply pile.

name: Remodel
description: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 2 more.

name: Sentry
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Trash or discard any number of them, then return the rest in any order.

name: Smithy
description: Draw 3 cards.

name: Spyglass
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. Look at the top card of your deck. Choose whether to discard it or return it to the top of your deck.

name: Reliquary
description: Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. You may trash one revealed resource and gain coins equal to its value. Discard the other revealed cards.

name: Throne Room
description: You may play an action card from your hand twice without spending another action.

name: Vassal
description: Gain 2 coins. Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action card, you may play it without spending an action. Otherwise, discard it.

name: Village
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 2 actions.

name: Witch
description: Draw 2 cards. Attack: gain a Curse.

name: Workshop
description: Gain a card costing up to 4.

name: Tunnel
description: Worth 2 VP. When you discard this outside cleanup, you may gain a Gold.

special_effects.prompt: Reveal Tunnel to gain a Gold?
special_effects.label: Discard: Gain Gold

name: Farmland
description: Worth 2 VP. When you gain this, trash a card from your hand and gain a different card costing exactly 2 more.

name: Fool's Gold
description: Gain 1 coin the first time you play this each turn. Gain 4 coins each later time.

name: Trader
description: Trash a card from your hand. Gain one Silver for each coin it costs. When you gain a card while this is in your hand, you may exchange that card for a Silver.

special_effects.prompt: Reveal Trader to exchange the gained card for a Silver?
special_effects.label: React: Take Silver

name: Margrave
description: Draw 3 cards. Gain 1 buy. Attack: discard down to 3 cards in hand.

name: Border Village
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 2 actions. When you gain this, gain a cheaper card.

name: Cartographer
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Discard any number, then return the rest in any order.

name: Crossroads
description: Draw 1 card for each victory card in your hand. The first time you play this each turn, gain 3 actions.

name: Develop
description: Trash a card from your hand. Gain one card costing exactly 1 more and one costing exactly 1 less on top of your deck, in either order.

name: Haggler
description: Gain 2 coins. This turn, whenever you buy a card, gain a cheaper non-victory card.

name: Highway
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. Cards cost 1 less this turn, to a minimum of 0.

name: Inn
description: Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 actions. Discard 2 cards. When you gain this, you may shuffle any action cards from your discard pile into your deck.

special_effects.prompt: Choose 2 cards from your hand to discard.
special_effects.label: Discard 2

name: Jack of All Trades
description: Gain a Silver. Look at the top card of your deck and choose whether to discard it. Draw until you have 5 cards in hand. You may trash a non-resource card from your hand.

special_effects.prompt: You may trash a non-resource card from your hand.
special_effects.label: Trash Non-Resource

name: Oasis
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action and 1 coin. Discard 1 card.

special_effects.prompt: Choose 1 card from your hand to discard.
special_effects.label: Discard 1

name: Scheme
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. During cleanup, you may put one action card from play on top of your deck.

name: Spice Merchant
description: You may discard a resource from your hand. If you do, choose one: draw 2 cards and gain 1 action; gain 1 buy and 2 coins; or gain 3 coins.

name: Stables
description: You may discard a resource. If you do, draw 3 cards and gain 1 action.

name: Kettle
description: Gain 2 coins and 1 buy. This turn, whenever you gain an action card, attack: gain a Curse.

name: Hound
description: Draw 2 cards. If you then have 5 or fewer cards in hand, draw 2 more cards.

name: Trail
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. When you gain, trash, or discard this outside cleanup, you may play it.

name: Weaver
description: Choose either to gain 2 Silvers or to gain a card costing up to 4. When you discard this outside cleanup, you may play it.

name: Raider
description: Gain a cheaper card. Attack: gain a Curse. When you gain this while another action card is in play, play this immediately.

name: Hut
description: Draw 4 cards. Discard 2 cards. If you discarded an action card this way, attack: gain a Curse.

special_effects.prompt: Choose 2 cards from your hand to discard.
special_effects.label: Discard 2, Attack

name: Starfall
description: Gain 1 buy and 2 coins. When you gain or trash this, gain 2 coins.

name: Bazaar
description: Gain 1 buy and 7 coins, then lose 1 of those coins for each card left in your hand, to a minimum of 0. When you gain this, trash up to 2 cards from your hand.

name: Wheelwright
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. You may discard a card to gain an action card costing no more than it.

name: Sunspire
description: Gain 1 action. Reduce your end-turn cooldown by 1 second this turn.

name: Hourglass
description: Reduce your end-turn cooldown by 0.5 seconds for the rest of the conquest, then trash this.

name: Dusk
description: Reduce your end-turn cooldown by 3 seconds this turn, then end your turn.

name: Bargain
description: Gain 3 coins. Gain a Curse to your hand.

name: Hexeater
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. You may trash up to 2 Curses from your hand. Draw 1 card and gain 1 coin for each one trashed this way.

special_effects.prompt: You may trash up to 2 Curses from your hand.
special_effects.label: Trash Curses for Bonus

name: Hedgewarden
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. While this is in your hand, attacks do not affect you.

name: Thornbinder
description: Gain 2 coins. You may trash a Curse from your hand. If you do, gain 2 coins. Attack: gain a Curse.

special_effects.prompt: You may trash a Curse from your hand.
special_effects.label: Trash Curse for +2

name: Idol
description: Worth 1 VP. Worth 1 more VP for each Curse you own.

name: Ingot
description: Gain 3 coins. When you gain this, gain a Curse.

name: Hexmill
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. You may discard a Curse. If you do, gain 2 coins.

name: Bonecart
description: Gain 1 coin. You may put a card costing up to 4 from your trash pile into your discard pile.

special_effects.prompt: You may put a card costing up to 4 from your trash pile into your discard pile.
special_effects.label: Reclaim from Trash

name: Bonepicker
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. If your trash pile has 5 or more cards, gain 2 coins.

name: Shrine
description: Worth 1 VP. Worth 1 more VP per 4 cards in your trash pile.

name: Keystone
description: Draw 1 card for each relic you have. Gain 1 action.

name: Pilgrim
description: Gain 2 coins. Trash this. You may replace one of your relics with a newly drafted relic.

name: Minute
description: Gain 1 action and 1 coin. Attack: your end-turn cooldown is 2 seconds longer this turn.

name: Vigil
description: Gain 1 coin. At the start of your next turn, reduce your end-turn cooldown by 2 seconds that turn. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Caravan
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 coin. At the start of your next turn, draw 1 card and gain 1 coin. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Ferry
description: Gain 1 action. At the start of your next turn, draw 2 cards. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Merchant Ship
description: Gain 2 coins. At the start of your next turn, gain 2 coins. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Lighthouse
description: Gain 1 coin. At the start of your next turn, gain 1 coin. Keep this card in play until then. While this is in play, attacks do not affect you.

name: Courier
description: At the start of your next turn, draw 1 card and gain 1 action and 1 coin. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Owl
description: Draw 1 card. At the start of your next turn, gain 1 buy and 2 coins. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Haven
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. You may set a card from your hand aside. At the start of your next turn, put it into your hand. Keep this card in play until then.

special_effects.prompt: You may set a card from your hand aside until your next turn.
special_effects.label: Set a Card Aside

name: Causeway
description: Gain 1 buy and 1 coin. At the start of your next turn, cards cost 1 less that turn. Keep this card in play until then.

name: Vault
description: Draw 2 cards. You may discard any number of cards for 1 coin each. Each other player may discard 2 cards to draw 1 card.

name: Bishop
description: Gain 1 coin and 1 VP token. Trash a card from your hand. Gain 1 VP token for each 2 coins in its cost. Each other player may trash a card from their hand.

name: City
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 2 actions. If at least 1 supply pile is empty, draw 1 card. If at least 2 supply piles are empty, gain 1 buy and 1 coin.

name: Clerk
description: Gain 2 coins. Each other player with at least 5 cards in hand puts a card from their hand on top of their deck. At the start of your turn, you may play this from your hand without using an action.

name: Forge
description: Trash any number of cards from your hand. Gain a card costing exactly the total cost of the trashed cards.

name: War Chest
description: The player to your left names a card. Gain a card costing up to 5, except cards named for War Chests this turn.

name: Grand Market
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action, 1 buy, and 2 coins. You cannot buy this while a Copper is in play.

name: Investment
description: Trash a card from your hand. Choose one: gain 1 coin, or trash this and reveal your hand to gain 1 VP token for each differently named resource there.

name: King's Court
description: You may play an action card from your hand three times without spending another action.

name: Charlatan
description: Gain 3 coins. Each other player gains a Curse. Curses are resources worth 1 coin when played.

name: Mint
description: You may reveal a resource from your hand, then gain a copy. When you gain this, trash the non-duration resources you played this turn.

name: Monument
description: Gain 2 coins and 1 VP token.

name: Bank
description: Gain 1 coin for each resource in play.

name: Quarry
description: Gain 1 coin. Action cards cost 2 less this turn, to a minimum of 0.

name: Rabble
description: Draw 3 cards. Attack: each other player reveals the top 3 cards of their deck, discards the resources and actions, and puts the rest back on top in any order.

name: Hoard
description: Gain 2 coins. This turn, when you gain a victory card that you bought, gain a Gold.

name: Watchtower
description: Draw until you have 6 cards in hand. When you gain a card, you may reveal this from hand to trash it or put it on top of your deck.

name: Crystal Ball
description: Gain 1 coin. Look at the top card of your deck. You may trash it, discard it, or play it if it is a resource or action; otherwise leave it on top.

name: Worker's Village
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 2 actions and 1 buy.

name: Tiara
description: Gain 1 buy. You may play a resource from your hand twice without using an action. This turn, when you gain a card, you may put it on top of your deck.

name: Anvil
description: Gain 1 coin. You may discard a resource from your hand to gain a card costing up to 4.

name: Peddler
description: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action and 1 coin. During your Buy phase, only this card costs 2 less per action card in play, to a minimum of 0.

name: Collection
description: Gain 2 coins and 1 buy. This turn, whenever you gain an action card, gain 1 VP token.

name: Expand
description: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 3 more.

name: Granary
description: Reveal your hand. Draw 1 card for each resource in it.

name: Platinum
description: Gain 5 coins.

name: Colony
description: Worth 10 VP.

name: Amulet
description: Now and at the start of your next turn, choose one: +1 coin; trash a card from your hand; or gain a Silver.

name: Artificer
description: +1 Card, +1 Action, and +1 coin. Discard any number of cards. You may gain a card onto your deck costing exactly 1 coin per card discarded.

name: Bridge Troll
description: Each other player takes their -1 coin token. Now and at the start of your next turn, +1 Buy. While this is in play, cards cost 1 less on your turns.

name: Caravan Guard
description: +1 Card and +1 Action. At the start of your next turn, +1 coin. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first play this from your hand.

name: Coin of the Realm
description: Worth 1 coin. Put it on your Tavern mat. After you play an Action card, you may call this for +2 Actions.

name: Distant Lands
description: Put this on your Tavern mat. Worth 4 VP if it is on your Tavern mat at the end of the game, otherwise 0 VP.

name: Dungeon
description: +1 Action. Now and at the start of your next turn, +2 Cards, then discard 2 Cards.

name: Duplicate
description: Put this on your Tavern mat. When you gain a card costing up to 6 coins, you may call this to gain a copy of that card.

name: Gear
description: +2 Cards. Set aside up to 2 cards from your hand face down under this. At the start of your next turn, put them into your hand.

name: Giant
description: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it is face down, +1 coin. If it is face up, +5 coins, and each other player reveals the top card of their deck, trashes it if it costs from 3 to 6 coins, and otherwise discards it and gains a Curse.

name: Guide
description: +1 Card and +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this to discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

name: Haunted Woods
description: Until your next turn, when any other player buys a card, they put their hand onto their deck in any order. At the start of your next turn, +3 Cards.

name: Hireling
description: At the start of each of your turns for the rest of the game, +1 Card. This stays in play.

name: Lost City
description: +2 Cards and +2 Actions. When you gain this, each other player draws a card.

name: Magpie
description: +1 Card and +1 Action. Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Treasure, put it into your hand. If it is an Action or Victory card, gain a Magpie.

name: Messenger
description: +1 Buy and +1 coin. You may put your deck into your discard pile. When this is your first buy in a turn, gain a card costing up to 4 coins, and each other player gains a copy of it.

name: Miser
description: Choose one: put a Copper from your hand onto your Tavern mat; or +1 coin per Copper on your Tavern mat.

modes.label: Put a Copper on your Tavern mat

name: Page
description: +1 Card and +1 Action. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Treasure Hunter.

name: Peasant
description: +1 Buy and +1 coin. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Soldier.

name: Port
description: +1 Card and +2 Actions. When you gain this, gain another Port.

name: Ranger
description: +1 Buy. Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it is face up, +5 Cards.

name: Ratcatcher
description: +1 Card and +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this to trash a card from your hand.

name: Raze
description: +1 Action. Trash this or a card from your hand. Look at one card from the top of your deck per coin the trashed card costs. Put one into your hand and discard the rest.

name: Relic
description: Worth 2 coins. Each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Royal Carriage
description: +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. After you play an Action card, if it is still in play, you may call this to replay that Action.

name: Storyteller
description: +1 Action. Play up to 3 Treasures from your hand. +1 Card. Pay all your coins. +1 Card per coin paid.

name: Swamp Hag
description: Until your next turn, when any other player buys a card, they gain a Curse. At the start of your next turn, +3 coins.

name: Transmogrify
description: +1 Action. Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this to trash a card from your hand and gain a card costing up to 1 more onto your hand.

name: Treasure Trove
description: Worth 2 coins. When you play this, gain a Gold and a Copper.

name: Wine Merchant
description: +1 Buy and +4 coins. Put this on your Tavern mat. At the end of your Buy phase, if you have at least 2 coins, you may discard this from your Tavern mat.

name: Treasure Hunter
description: +1 Action and +1 coin. Gain a Silver per card the player to your right gained in their last turn. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Warrior.

name: Warrior
description: +2 Cards. For each Traveller you have in play, each other player discards the top card of their deck and trashes it if it costs exactly 3 or 4 coins. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Hero.

name: Hero
description: +2 coins. Gain a Treasure. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Champion.

name: Champion
description: +1 Action. For the rest of the game, when another player plays an Attack, it does not affect you, and when you play an Action card, +1 Action. This stays in play.

name: Soldier
description: +2 coins, plus +1 coin per other Attack you have in play. Each other player with 4 or more cards in hand discards a card. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Fugitive.

name: Fugitive
description: +2 Cards and +1 Action. Discard a card. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Disciple.

name: Disciple
description: You may play an Action card from your hand twice. Gain a copy of it. When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Teacher.

name: Teacher
description: Put this on your Tavern mat. At the start of your turn, you may call this to move your +1 Card, +1 Action, +1 Buy, or +1 coin token to an Action Supply pile.

name: Alms
description: Once per turn: If you have no Treasures in play, gain a card costing up to 4 coins.

name: Ball
description: Take your -1 coin token. Gain 2 cards each costing up to 4 coins.

name: Bonfire
description: Trash up to 2 cards you have in play.

name: Borrow
description: Once per turn: +1 Buy. If your -1 Card token is not on your deck, put it there and +1 coin.

name: Expedition
description: Draw 2 extra cards for your next hand.

name: Ferry
description: Move your -2 coin cost token to an Action Supply pile. Cards from that pile cost 2 less on your turns.

name: Inheritance
description: Once per game: Set aside a non-Command Action card from the Supply costing up to 5 coins. Move your Estate token to it. During your turns, Estates are also Actions with that card's text.

name: Lost Arts
description: Move your +1 Action token to an Action Supply pile. When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Action.

name: Mission
description: Once per turn: If the previous turn was not yours, take another turn after this one, during which you cannot buy cards.

name: Pathfinding
description: Move your +1 Card token to an Action Supply pile. When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Card.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Once per turn: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up); then if it is face up, choose up to 3 differently named cards you have in play and gain a copy of each.

name: Plan
description: Move your Trashing token to an Action Supply pile. When you buy a card from that pile, you may trash a card from your hand.

name: Quest
description: You may discard an Attack, two Curses, or six cards. If you do, gain a Gold.

name: Raid
description: Gain a Silver per Silver you have in play. Each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Save
description: Once per turn: +1 Buy. Set aside a card from your hand, and put it into your hand at end of turn after drawing.

name: Scouting Party
description: +1 Buy. Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Discard 3 and put the rest back in any order.

name: Seaway
description: Gain an Action card costing up to 4 coins. Move your +1 Buy token to its pile.

name: Trade
description: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Gain a Silver per card you trashed.

name: Training
description: Move your +1 coin token to an Action Supply pile. When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 coin.

name: Travelling Fair
description: +2 Buys. When you gain a card this turn, you may put it onto your deck.
